title: Documenting and keeping the documentation alive

videos.script: Every system has documentation. {{title}} The question is whether anybody believes it, and whether they should. {{wiki}} At Carreto there is a wiki page about Payments. It is clear, well drawn, and three years out of date. Ícaro, a junior developer, believed it, and it cost him six working days. {{views}} This lesson is about writing less, and keeping it true. First, what is worth writing down at all, and for whom. A finance director and a new developer need different pictures of the same system. {{c4}} You will meet two ways of choosing those pictures: the C4 model, with its four levels of zoom, and the four plus one views. Enough to choose, not to master. {{repo}} Then where documentation should live. Next to the code, changed in the same pull request, with diagrams written as text. {{rot}} And finally why documents rot, who owns them, what dates they carry, and when the right thing to do with a page is to delete it.
